facts.statement: checkpoint_state_drained requires empty policy execution entries. External policy execution registers before infer and erases after terminal; ordinary DRAINED does not permit this pending entry.
At real drain deadline finish_checkpoint_drain(true) reports CENSORED and quits main loop without independently settling entries; run then aborts ingress and NULLs pipelines.
STOP POLLIN is consumed before HUP rejection; timeout resets after READY. A child nonzero also initiates peer containment.
Native STOP reader consumes POLLIN STOP before rejecting HUP, so the ordinary parent STOP then close is supported.

historical_correction: v1 source-only receipt used an incorrect client filename and attributed the STOP/HUP source anchors to Python; this v2 corrects those source pointers, without changing causal interpretation.
interpretation: Front EPIPE after an inference response is proven. CENSORED drain or another native failure could disconnect an in-flight front, but original READY/STOP/DRAINED/CENSORED/native stderr is unavailable; no particular stop path or cause is established. No cancellation, time budget, counter or success predicate change is authorized by this diagnosis.
